description: This file defines the LockingSessionConnection class in the AWS SDK for DynamoDB, adding locking logic to the standard session connection for concurrency control.

classes.name: LockingSessionConnection
classes.description: Extends StandardSessionConnection, adding locking logic via DynamoDB's updateItem to control concurrent access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection with a DynamoDbClient and configuration array.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock and read data atomically by retrying until success or timeout.
